sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for an original medieval tactical RPG, transparent RGBA PNG.
Create one landscape sprite sheet with EXACTLY 12 equal columns and 8 equal rows, preferably 1536x1024, each cell 128x128. NO grid lines, labels, text, floor, background or cast shadow. Every full-body character stays inside its cell with generous transparent margin. Feet on identical cell baseline y=110, torso centered x=64. Pixel art with crisp hard edged pixel clusters, as if authored at 48-pixel-tall characters and enlarged by nearest neighbor; dark navy outlines, clear warm highlights, muted jewel colors, detailed readable costumes, classic handheld tactics proportions, three-quarter view from above. No existing game characters.
Each ROW is one consistent original character repeated in twelve poses. Row 1 chestnut-haired woman sword commander, ivory mantle navy tunic gold trim. Row 2 silver armored lance knight with blue plume. Row 3 auburn-haired green-cloaked archer with bow. Row 4 navy-robed silver-haired mage with cyan orb. Row 5 dark-skinned white-and-teal robed staff healer. Row 6 chestnut horse and blue armored lancer rider, whole mount visible within cell. Row 7 red-haired axe warrior wearing russet and cream. Row 8 short-haired turquoise-scarved duelist with light sword.
Every row uses SAME column order:
1 front/south idle, 2 front/south subtle alternate idle with cloak motion,
3 left/west idle, 4 left/west walking stride,
5 right/east idle, 6 right/east walking stride,
7 back/north idle, 8 back/north walking stride,
9 front/south walking left foot, 10 front/south walking right foot,
11 attack or spell release clearly angled right (staff healer heal pose), 12 recoil hurt.
Keep identical character design and size between cells; mounted row naturally wider but same baseline. All 96 individual cells must have only ONE character or mounted pair, no overlaps. Preserve true transparency. Consistent art and source pixel density throughout.
alpha_edit_prompt: Edit this exact sprite atlas. Preserve all 96 characters, their positions, their designs, poses, pixels, colors, weapons, row and column layout and overall image dimensions. Change ONLY the multicolored brown/gray background into genuine fully transparent alpha around every sprite. Remove all background texture, gradients, mattes, and shadows. Do not add checkerboard pixels. Keep crisp pixel art outlines intact and no color halos. Maintain twelve columns and eight rows exactly. Transparent RGBA PNG, no other changes.
terrain_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel art environment atlas for a medieval tactical RPG. Create a square 1024x1024 transparent PNG laid out in an EXACT 4 by 4 grid, sixteen equal 256x256 cells. Each cell is an independent asset; no labels, no text, no borders or grid lines. Artwork uses crisp pixel clusters, limited muted greens, warm ochres, blue teal water, weathered beige stone, dark indigo shadows; classic handheld strategy RPG quality, lush detailed readable art, overhead three-quarter viewpoint. Asset contents in row-major order:
row1: seamless short sage meadow grass filling whole cell; seamless ochre dirt path filling whole cell; seamless deep teal river water subtle pixel ripples filling whole cell; seamless old pale cobblestone filling whole cell.
row2: seamless mossy blue-gray stone floor filling whole cell; wooden bridge planks filling whole cell; earth and grass bank with water on RIGHT half (vertical shoreline); earth and grass bank with water on LEFT half (vertical shoreline).
row3: ONE full broad oak tree with trunk and dense irregular layered green leaves, transparent background and wide margin; ONE full pale willow tree with drooping leaves, transparent background and wide margin; ONE shrub and small gray rocks, transparent background and wide margin; ONE old low stone wall segment, transparent background and wide margin.
row4: ONE full small medieval cream plaster blue-slate roof house viewed from above at slight angle, transparent background and wide margin; ONE matching smaller cottage with ochre roof, transparent background and wide margin; ONE gold objective banner on a stone base with blue pennant, transparent background; ONE pale healing shrine with cyan inset, transparent background.
All objects centered and completely within their cells with at least 20px transparent margin, bases at consistent y=224. Same source pixel density and light from upper left. Objects must not cross cell boundaries. The first eight tile cells are opaque textures and the final eight object cells truly transparent outside objects. No characters, no imitation of any existing game assets.
